Perception_Processing_Sensor_Function.Description: The Agent turns on the Virtual Camera (a request for an input to user) to understand if a danger is on the route in fron to the Agent. Format Perceived Data: [ 1- String "Danger on the route!", 2- TPosition_Train_Coords Precondition_Position 3- TPosition_Train_Coords Postcondition_Position ]
Get current Position: 1- City: Integer 2- Route: Integer 3- Step: Integer
